destination.description: The resolved destination satisfying the intent, with clarification null. If the referent or route cannot be established, or the route is blocked, return destination null and a target-specific clarification instead. Do not merely repeat an unresolved target as a location name. Missing exits alone do not block discovery of a new place.

clarification.description: A target-specific question or explanation when destination is null. Must be null when destination is an object. Do not ask whom to follow unless following is actually the requested intent.
